evaluation_rules: same raw FER image for every model version
images normalized exactly as each reviewed implementation expects (intensity/255.0, standardized pixel coordinates)
no label-based selection during activation extraction
raw view and flip view kept as separate records
no TTA averaging before intermediate-representation analysis
sample row/index retained to guarantee alignment across versions

final_pixel_gnn.semantic: Pixel-level contextual graph representations prior to motif pooling

occurrence_raw.semantic: Spatial motif occurrence raw unprojected feature vectors

scale_candidates.comparable_across_versions: v2 and v2.1 only (v1 is single-scale 12x12)
scale_candidates.semantic: Multi-scale candidate motif node representations prior to gating

pre_motif_gnn.semantic: Fused motif node representations entering the motif graph transformer

post_motif_gnn.semantic: Contextualized motif representations after geometric relational attention

fusion_representation.hook_target: direct output in v2.1; concat([h_pixel_readout, h_motif_readout], dim=-1) in v1 and v2
fusion_representation.semantic: Concatenated pixel + motif joint representation feeding classifier
